identity.premise: A persistent, numbered proof rail intersects the content exactly where an operator must verify a claim.
identity.carrier_rule: Let the proof rail organize every consequential decision.

marks.role: This direction uses no separate mark.
marks.clear_space: Not applicable until a mark is commissioned.
marks.minimum_size: Not applicable until a mark is commissioned.
prohibited_uses: Do not invent a placeholder logo.

recognition_tests: The evidence seam remains recognizable without the accent color.

semantic_mappings: Signal means verified and is never decorative.
modes: Light is canonical; print preserves role separation.
color.contrast_method: Verify WCAG contrast from rendered foreground and background pairs.

typography.measure: Body copy stays between 45 and 70 characters.
typography.responsive_behavior: Display copy wraps to two lines before scale drops.

spatial.grid: Twelve columns desktop, eight tablet, four mobile.

transformations.rule: Proof and rationale share a spread.

shape_rules: Use square evidence fields and one-pixel rules.
iconography_rules: Use labeled symbols only when text is insufficient.
imagery_rules: Use owned working evidence with explicit crops.
material_rules: Paper and ink carry the system; signal color marks state.
prohibited_uses: No decorative gradients or detached logo rows.

motion.rationale: Motion reveals proof state without changing reading order.

principles: State the decision before the explanation.
approved_examples: Evidence is current through this revision.

application_modes.rule: Use the full seam for orientation and proof.
Use numbered markers and quiet rules.
Remove display scale but retain evidence order.

decision_rationale: The carrier turns evidence into structure.
prohibited_substitutions: Do not replace the seam with generic cards.
acceptance_checks: Every consequential claim remains adjacent to evidence.
drift_checks: Review palette, type transfer, carrier, responsive behavior, and provenance together.
